title: More ways to make images and video
summary:
New image, video and text models filled the day, while headless login and longer-range model health views made the tools around them more useful.

Amazon Nova added `nova-canvas` for image generation and editing, plus `nova-reel` for text-to-video and image-to-video. Qwen Image added generation and editing with up to three input images. Grok Imagine added two image options and a video model. Configuration fixes addressed access errors for Nova and existing Qwen models.

`wan-fast` added 5-second, 480p text-to-video and image-to-video generation without a paid-only restriction. LTX-2 returned with a direct video backend, followed by a routing fix so requests reach it. Video requests now default `audio` to `true` for models that support it; `audio=false` still opts out.

The `nova` alias now points to Nova 2 Lite, with reasoning, tools and a 1,048,576-token context window; `nova-fast` remains available. `grok` moved to Grok 4.1 Fast with a 2M-token context, alongside a new `grok-reasoning` option. MIDIjourney now has a Haiku-backed base model and a paid-only `midijourney-large` backed by Opus.

highlights.title: Nova 2 Lite joins chat
highlights.text: Use `nova` for reasoning and tools with a 1,048,576-token context window. The previous Nova Micro option remains available as `nova-fast`. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=nova).

highlights.title: Nova Canvas makes variations
highlights.text: Generate images with `nova-canvas`, or supply an image and prompt to make an edited variation. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=nova-canvas).

highlights.title: Nova Reel makes video
highlights.text: Use `nova-reel` for text-to-video or image-to-video generation, with durations up to 30 seconds in 6-second steps. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=nova-reel).

highlights.title: Qwen images and edits
highlights.text: Generate with `qwen-image`, or provide up to three input images for an edit. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=qwen-image).

highlights.title: Grok gains a reasoning option
highlights.text: `grok` now uses Grok 4.1 Fast, and `grok-reasoning` adds a reasoning variant. Both have a 2M-token context window. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

highlights.title: Grok Imagine makes images
highlights.text: Generate images with `grok-imagine` or the paid-only `grok-imagine-pro`. [Browse the models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=grok-imagine).

highlights.title: Grok Imagine makes video
highlights.text: Generate 720p videos from 1 to 15 seconds with `grok-video-pro`. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=grok-video-pro).

highlights.title: LTX-2 video returns
highlights.text: Use `ltx-2` for text-to-video generation at up to 10 seconds. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=ltx-2).

highlights.title: Wan gets a fast option
highlights.text: Use `wan-fast` for 5-second, 480p video from a prompt or an input image. It has no paid-only restriction. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=wan-fast).

highlights.title: MIDIjourney gets two tiers
highlights.text: Use `midijourney` with Claude Haiku 4.5, or choose the paid-only `midijourney-large` backed by Claude Opus 4.6. Both keep the music assistant’s tool support. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=midijourney).

highlights.title: Login without a redirect
highlights.text: CLIs and headless apps can request a device code, have a user approve access in a browser, then receive an API key with the approved permissions. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Longer model health views
highlights.text: Check model health over 24 hours or 7 days in the model monitor, alongside its shorter views. [Open the model monitor](https://model-monitor.pollinations.ai).
